title: Jayantia Buranji
author: Dr. Suryya Kumar Bhuyan
description: Crucial diplomatic chronicle published by the Department of Historical and Antiquarian Studies (DHAS), containing original Assamese and Tai manuscript accounts of diplomatic relations, envoy exchanges (Katakis), border treaties, and military expeditions between the Tai Ahom kingdom and the Jaintia hill realm.
